rules.statement: Nix recovered from the dangerous deck decryption after V breached the system and preserved its data. Nix and V discussed the rescue afterward.
Nix recovered after V cut the power during the dangerous deck decryption; their recovery conversation established that the deck's data was wiped.
V delivered the old spellbook tablet to Nix and completed its sale. The agreed payment amount is not established by this observation.
Mama Welles held Jackie's ofrenda at El Coyote Cojo, and V took part through the ceremony and toast.
At Jackie's ofrenda, V honored him with Jackie's book and a passage read from it. Mama Welles was there for the ceremony.
At Jackie's ofrenda, V honored him with Jackie's basketball. Mama Welles was there for the ceremony.
At Jackie's ofrenda, V honored him with Jackie's tequila. Mama Welles was there for the ceremony.
At Jackie's ofrenda, V honored him with Jackie's belt. Mama Welles was there for the ceremony.
V reminded Mama Welles how important Misty was to Jackie and encouraged Mama to invite Misty to dinner.
After Jackie's ofrenda, V accepted his motorcycle keys from Mama Welles and promised to take care of it.

Cynthia told V that the man she visited was her ripperdoc, that she had extensively changed her appearance, and that her son's appearance reflected her original genetics. This is Cynthia's explanation; she was not admitting an affair.
V told Pepe what Cynthia had explained, urged him to recognize that she loved him, and advised him to forgive the concealed appearance change. Pepe accepted that advice during their conversation.
Pepe later messaged V that, despite not knowing everything about Cynthia's past, he knew she loved him and was choosing their marriage.
Pepe later messaged V that Cynthia was no longer in his home and that he no longer trusted her. This establishes their separation, not which particular earlier advice V selected.

V agreed to Coach Fred's proposal to deliberately lose the Razor Hughes final for a larger payment. This records the agreement only; the actual fight result and V's motive in any loss remain separate.
V defeated Razor Hughes in the final boxing bout, which Coach Fred officiated.
V lost the final boxing bout to Razor Hughes. Coach Fred officiated and Razor retained the title. This does not establish whether V deliberately threw the fight.
V beat Ozob in the Pacifica boxing bout without detonating his grenade. Ozob surrendered, acknowledged the result and paid V afterward.

Coach Fred heard that Ozob's head exploded in the Pacifica bout and sent V a message about it. Fred did not witness it himself; Ozob's death is not a surviving personal memory for an Ozob companion copy.
Coach Fred heard that V won the Pacifica boxing bout against the man with a grenade for a nose and congratulated V by message. Fred did not witness the bout himself.
V disclosed the following save-established instruction: V asked Delamain to take Jackie's remains to his family, and Delamain identified Mama Welles as the recipient.

V disclosed the following save-established instruction: V initially asked Delamain to wait at the No-Tell Motel with Jackie's remains. This instruction alone does not state the later delivery destination.

V disclosed the following save-established instruction: V asked Delamain to take Jackie's remains to Viktor's clinic. This instruction alone does not establish what happened to the body at the clinic.
Wilson's shooting competition recorded V in first place. Wilson judged the contest.
Wilson's shooting competition recorded Rudy in first place and V in second. Wilson judged the contest.
V agreed to help Jesse reach a ripperdoc during his implant emergency.
Jesse recovered sufficiently to call V, confirmed that he had transferred payment for the help, and thanked V.

V delivered Haruyoshi alive to Dennis. Dennis acknowledged the completed extraction, and Haruyoshi spoke with them at the handoff. This does not mean V heard Haruyoshi's optional account of what happened in Japan.
V accepted Dennis's retrieval job. Dennis directed V to the Kabuki waterfront and a fridge marked No Future, with further instructions to follow.
